nodes.name: Felix and Sable ride forest road
aliases: Felix and Sable ride forest road
nodes.description: Felix and Sable travel quickly together along a dirt road through the forest.
evidence: Felix and Sable ride a dirt road through tall pines, moving at pace.
Sable rides beside Felix, her long dark brown hair pulled back under a riding hood.

nodes.name: Felix predicts Wren's smuggling route
nodes.description: Felix states that if Wren has the map, he will move it through the eastern fences as he has done before.
evidence:
FELIX
If Wren has the map he will move it through the eastern fences. He has done it before.

nodes.name: Felix identifies Wren as powerful nobleman
aliases: Felix identifies Wren as powerful nobleman
nodes.description: Felix explains his certainty by revealing that Wren is a nobleman with influence across three provinces.
evidence:
FELIX
Because of who he is. A nobleman with reach across three provinces.

SABLE
How can you be certain?

nodes.name: Felix says thief described wrong map
aliases: Felix says thief described wrong map
nodes.description: Felix explains that the thief's description matched a convincing but incorrect version of the map.
evidence:
FELIX
They described a map of the Northern Reaches drawn in red ink on reinforced parchment. That matches the work closely -- closely enough that someone who had seen it briefly or heard it described secondhand might believe it.

SABLE
What about the description the thief gave? You said it was wrong.

nodes.name: Felix cites Holt's fence report
nodes.description: Felix confirms that the red-ink description came from how Holt said the fence described the map.
evidence:
SABLE
Red ink.

FELIX
That is how Holt said the fence described it.

nodes.name: Felix explains thieves searched old hiding place
aliases: Felix explains thieves searched old hiding place
nodes.description: Felix says the thieves must have previously seen the map in his wooden box on the window alcove shelf and assumed it was still there.
evidence:
SABLE
And the chest -- where they found it. The window alcove?

FELIX
They must have seen it earlier in the wooden box I kept on the alcove shelf. They assumed it was still there when they came back for it.

nodes.name: Felix reveals he moved the map
aliases: Felix reveals he moved the map
nodes.description: Felix states that the map was no longer in the alcove because he had moved it, though not soon enough to prevent the larger problem.
evidence:
SABLE
But it was not.

FELIX
No. I had moved it. Too late, as it turns out.

nodes.name: Felix
nodes.description: Felix rides through the forest with Sable and explains his reasoning about Wren, the map, and the thieves.
evidence:
FELIX
If Wren has the map he will move it through the eastern fences.
Felix and Sable ride a dirt road through tall pines, moving at pace.

FELIX
No. I had moved it. Too late, as it turns out.

nodes.name: Sable
nodes.description: Sable rides beside Felix and questions him about Wren, the map description, and where the thieves searched.
evidence: Felix and Sable ride a dirt road through tall pines, moving at pace.
Sable rides beside Felix, her long dark brown hair pulled back under a riding hood.

SABLE
How can you be certain?

nodes.name: Wren
nodes.description: Wren is the influential nobleman Felix suspects would move the map through the eastern fences.
evidence: If Wren has the map he will move it through the eastern fences.
Because of who he is. A nobleman with reach across three provinces.

nodes.name: the thief
nodes.description: The thief is the person whose incorrect description of the map prompts Felix's explanation.
evidence: What about the description the thief gave? You said it was wrong.

nodes.name: Holt
nodes.description: Holt is the person Felix cites as the source for how the fence described the map.
evidence: That is how Holt said the fence described it.

nodes.name: the fence
nodes.description: The fence is the intermediary whose description of the map Holt reportedly relayed.
evidence: That is how Holt said the fence described it.

nodes.name: the thieves
nodes.description: The thieves are the people Felix says had seen the map earlier and returned expecting it to still be in its old hiding place.
evidence: They must have seen it earlier in the wooden box I kept on the alcove shelf.
They assumed it was still there when they came back for it.

nodes.name: the eastern fences

evidence: he will move it through the eastern fences.

the wooden box I kept on the alcove shelf.

evidence: the wooden box I kept on the alcove shelf.
